Hi all — ran an initial proration. Assumptions used: monthly seat rate = EUR 35.00/seat (per contract), billing period days = 31 (Dec), reduction effective 2026-12-09 (so unused days per seat = 22).

Preliminary calc (high level):
- Seats removed: 30 (120 -> 90)
- Per-seat unused days: 22/31 = 0.7097 of month
- Gross credit = 30 seats * EUR 35.00 * 0.7097 = EUR 744.79 (rounded)
- VAT treatment: client submitted EU VAT ID (GB999888777); pending confirmation whether reverse-charge applies based on supplied certificate. If reverse-charge applies, VAT on the credit would be zero on our side and Novarx should self-account. If not, we’ll apply local VAT at 20% (EUR 148.96) and credit gross+VAT accordingly.

I’ve attached a detailed breakdown CSV and a draft credit note for internal review. Laura
